said results from the first 11 completed drill holes identified two separate, significant mineralized domains at Gleeson, including a 123.6 m intercept grading 0.91% copper, 0.44 g/t of gold, and 5.27 g/t of silver from a depth of 601.7 m.

"These initial drill results are some of the best copper-gold-silver intercepts drilled in the western United States in the last 10 years," Executive Chairman Robert Friedland and President/CEO Taylor Melvin said. "These initial discovery results provide us with a glimpse into what we think could become a major new copper-gold-silver district less than 30 miles north of the historic Bisbee District, one of America's most famous and prolific mining districts."
